```{r}
library("wooldridge")
```

### Example 9.1

```{r}
data("crime1")

model_9_1_1 <- lm(narr86 ~ pcnv + avgsen + tottime + ptime86 +
                    qemp86 + inc86 + black + hispan,
                  data = crime1)
summary(model_9_1_1)
# Seems to be an error in the book.
# Although all coefficients and their standard errors are equal
# the intercept term is 0.569 instead of 0.596.
```

```{r}
model_9_1_2 <- lm(narr86 ~ pcnv + avgsen + tottime + ptime86 +
                    qemp86 + inc86 + black + hispan + pcnvsq +
                    pt86sq + inc86sq,
                  data = crime1)
summary(model_9_1_2)
```

```{r}
anova(model_9_1_1, model_9_1_2)
```

### Example 9.2

```{r}
data("hprice1")

model_9_2_1 <- lm(price ~ lotsize + sqrft + bdrms, data = hprice1)
fit2_1 <- model_9_2_1[["fitted.values"]]^2
fit3_1 <- model_9_2_1[["fitted.values"]]^3
model_9_2_1_reset <- lm(price ~ lotsize + sqrft + bdrms + fit2_1 + fit3_1,
                        data = hprice1)
anova(model_9_2_1, model_9_2_1_reset)
```

```{r}
model_9_2_2 <- lm(lprice ~ llotsize + lsqrft + bdrms, data = hprice1)
fit2_2 <- model_9_2_2[["fitted.values"]]^2
fit3_2 <- model_9_2_2[["fitted.values"]]^3
model_9_2_2_reset <- lm(lprice ~ llotsize + lsqrft + bdrms + fit2_2 + fit3_2,
                        data = hprice1)
anova(model_9_2_2, model_9_2_2_reset)
```

### Table 9.2

```{r}
data("wage2")

model_t9_2_1 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + tenure + married + south + urban +
                     black,
                   data = wage2)
summary(model_t9_2_1)
```

```{r}
model_t9_2_2 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + tenure + married + south + urban +
                     black + IQ,
                   data = wage2)
summary(model_t9_2_2)
```

```{r}
model_t9_2_3 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + tenure + married + south + urban +
                     black + IQ + IQ * educ,
                   data = wage2)
summary(model_t9_2_3)
```

### Example 9.4

```{r}
data("crime2")

model_9_4_1 <- lm(lcrmrte ~ unem + llawexpc,
                  data = crime2,
                  subset = (d87 == 1))
summary(model_9_4_1)
```

```{r}
model_9_4_2 <- lm(lcrmrte ~ unem + llawexpc + lcrmrt_1,
                  data = crime2,
                  subset = (d87 == 1))
summary(model_9_4_2)
```

### Example 9.8

```{r}
data("rdchem")

model_9_8_1 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg, data = rdchem)
summary(model_9_8_1)
```

```{r, fig.align="center", fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
# See the outliers
with(rdchem, plot(sales, rdintens, pch = 16))
```

```{r}
# Test without the biggest firm
model_9_8_2 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg,
                  data = rdchem,
                  subset = (sales < 30000))
summary(model_9_8_2)
```

Hmmm, slightly different result than in the book

```{r}
# Dummy for the biggest firm
big <- as.numeric(rdchem[["sales"]] == max(rdchem[["sales"]]))
model_9_8_3 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg + big, data = rdchem)
summary(model_9_8_3)
```

```{r}
# Dummy for highest rdintens
hi_rdint <- as.numeric(rdchem[["rdintens"]] == max(rdchem[["rdintens"]]))
model_9_8_4 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg + hi_rdint, data = rdchem)
summary(model_9_8_4)
```

```{r}
model_9_8_5 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg,
                  data = rdchem,
                  subset = (rdintens < max(rdintens)))
summary(model_9_8_5)
```

```{r}
# Without first and tenth firm
model_9_8_6 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg,
                  data = rdchem,
                  subset = (sales < max(sales) & rdintens < max(rdintens)))
summary(model_9_8_6)
```

Hmm, slighty different results

```{r}
model_9_8_7 <- lm(rdintens ~ sales + profmarg + big + hi_rdint, data = rdchem)
summary(model_9_8_7)
```

### Example 9.9

```{r}
data("rdchem")

model_9_9_1 <- lm(lrd ~ lsales + profmarg, data = rdchem)
summary(model_9_9_1)
```

```{r}
# Without the largest firm
model_9_9_2 <- lm(lrd ~ lsales + profmarg,
                  data = rdchem,
                  subset = (lsales < max(lsales)))
summary(model_9_9_2)
```

### Example 9.10

```{r}
data("infmrt")

model_9_10_1 <- lm(infmort ~ lpcinc + lphysic + lpopul,
                   data = infmrt,
                   subset = (year == 1990))
summary(model_9_10_1)
```

```{r}
model_9_10_2 <- lm(infmort ~ lpcinc + lphysic + lpopul,
                   data = infmrt,
                   subset = (year == 1990 & DC == 0))
summary(model_9_10_2)
```
